blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The situation at the Manila South Cemetery remained generally peaceful during this year’s Undas observance, the Manila Police District (MPD) said on Monday, Nov. 2. Sta. Ana Police Station commander Richard Villanueva gave the assessment on All Souls’ Day, the final day of the long weekend. “Okay naman po yung situation dito, generally peaceful,” Villanueva told reporters. (The situation here is okay and generally peaceful.)
